title: eranthemum pulchellum var. varians
intro: Eranthemum pulchellum var. varians, commonly known as Blue Butterfly Bush, is a flowering plant species in the family Acanthaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Blue Butterfly Bush include wound healing, antiseptic, and antidiarrheal effects. The bioactive constituents of Eranthemum pulchellum var. varians include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
